name: cinematic_orbit_volumetric
description: Cinematic orbit with multi-layer parallax scrolling and volumetric god rays. Primary path for the full surreal-ethereal-dancer series when maximum 3D cinematographic depth is required. Orbit radius and zoom tuned to the dancer's negative space composition — figure stays centered while background layers drift at independent speeds to create genuine volumetric depth without competing with body motion.

motions.note: 320° rather than 360° — avoids seam artifact on loop. 0.42 radius preserves figure centrality while generating enough angular shift to make nacre shimmer read as camera-driven rather than texture-baked.

motions.timing_cue: begins at 0.5s, peak at clip end
motions.note: 1.28x terminal zoom — draws viewer from full figure toward face/upper body by clip end. Matches hybrid_01 and hybrid_02 emotional arc (establish → intimate).

layers.name: background_swirls
layers.note: Counter-orbit drift creates hypnotic vortex feel. Dark line patterns move against camera — reinforces void depth.

layers.name: volumetric_haze
layers.note: Mid-speed haze layer sits between swirls and petals. Creates atmospheric depth plane — the light fog that enhances iridescence and separates figure from background.

layers.name: foreground_petals
layers.note: Petals move faster than camera and opposite to background — classic foreground parallax. Enhances perceived 3D volume. Petal flutter remains independent of parallax scroll.

lighting.note: Rays follow camera orbit angle — they shift as the camera moves, catching the nacre shimmer from new angles each moment. Softness set high to keep atmospheric rather than theatrical. Warm gold matches hybrid_01/03 palette; recolor to cool-white for hybrid_02/05.

per_hybrid_notes.hybrid_01_liquid_bloom_dance: Primary path. Warm gold rays + orbit matches marble undulation and golden lighting. Use at full settings.
per_hybrid_notes.hybrid_02_abalone_dreamscape: Use static camera (hybrid_02 spec) — swap to micro_float.json. If volumetric is desired, reduce orbit to 0.1 radius and recolor rays to cool-white.
per_hybrid_notes.hybrid_03_golden_flow_motion: Replace orbit with dolly_forward.json per hybrid_03 camera spec. Parallax layers valid — retain at these speeds.
per_hybrid_notes.hybrid_04_nacre_bloom: Locked camera per hybrid_04 spec — disable orbit and zoom. Parallax_scroll only, reduced to 0.3x speeds. God rays valid at low intensity.
per_hybrid_notes.hybrid_05_void_dancer: Replace with wide_to_portrait.json (35mm->85mm pull-in). Parallax layers valid. Ray color: cool-white to match jade-void palette.

prompt_keywords: volumetric god rays shifting with camera movement
inventive parallax scrolling on swirling background
background swirls drifting opposite to camera orbit
foreground petals parallax faster than mid-ground
dynamic highlight shifts catching nacre shimmer

control_strategy.rationale: Zoe raised to 0.98 (from 0.95 default) for true 3D volume needed by parallax layers. Higher depth signal ensures parallax layers have accurate Z-separation to work against. Canny held at 0.45 — edge reinforcement for fabric and petal boundaries without fighting the parallax softness.
